title: ആഫ്രിക്കൻ ഒച്ച് giant African land snail Invasion | Kerala's Hidden Threat & Amazing Gastropod Facts
description:
Did you know a snail could be a serious threat to agriculture, ecosystems—and even human health? 🐌
In this video, we explore the Giant African Land Snail, an invasive species wreaking havoc in parts of Kerala, India. Discover:
🔴 How and why it's considered one of the world’s worst invasive species
⚠️ The problems it's causing in Kerala – from crop damage to disease risk
🐌 The surprising difference between snails and slugs
💡 Uses of snails in medicine, cosmetics, and research
🤯 Fascinating and weird facts about gastropods you didn’t know!
Whether you're a nature enthusiast, biology student, or just curious about creepy-crawlies, this video has something for you. 🧐
